channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: The Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold is the best folding Pixel yet — but it doesn't beat Samsung's best
item.description: Google's latest foldable is an impressive device with key refinements over its predecessor, but it doesn't do enough to match Samsung's best.

item.title: Senators demand answers from TikTok over experiment that disabled safeguards
item.description: The safeguard was designed to prevent users from being overwhelmed by harmful content, but TikTok wanted to determine whether it made the app less engaging.

item.title: The KYY K3 portable monitor is 'cheap but remarkably cheerful' — now our favorite budget display drops to under $60
item.description: For the price, we found this lightweight display with magnetic smart cover 'does everything a basic 1080p portable monitor should do.'

item.title: Voici la liste des produits déclarés qui ne recevront pas de mise à jour Apple en 2026
item.description: Chaque année, Apple met fin au support de certaines générations de ses produits. Et comme il n'y a pas que les iPhone dans la vie, voici la liste de tous les produits Apple déclarés obsolètes par la marque. Cela ne veut pas dire pour autant qu'ils deviennent inutiles.

item.title: Meta brings Pocket, an app that lets you vibe-code and share games, to US users
item.description: Meta is bringing Pocket, its experimental AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to users across the U.S. after quietly testing it in Brazil.

item.title: Voici la meilleure offre pour s’offrir un téléviseur Samsung OLED à prix cassé juste avant la rentrée
item.description: Passer à l'OLED sans faire exploser son budget ? C'est désormais possible. Habituellement affiché au-dessus des 900 euros chez la concurrence, le téléviseur Samsung TQ55S90F tombe à 799 euros chez Joybuy. C'est tout simplement la meilleure offre du moment pour s'offrir l'incomparable qualité d'image OLED de Samsung sans se ruiner.

item.title: Samsung's Galaxy Book4 Edge is 'a zippy Copilot+ Windows 11 laptop' that's now £399 at Currys — half its usual price for a Snapdragon-powered ultraportable business machine
item.description: We found this vibrant 15.6-inch laptop delivered 'provides plenty of runway for productivity and personal tasks.'

item.title: The 2026 Startup Battlefield 200 is here — see who made the cut
item.description: We’re thrilled to unveil the 2026 Startup Battlefield 200, our annual handpicked list of the 200 most promising early-stage startups from around the world.

item.title: Patreon launches 30 new creator features, including short-form Clips and revamped discovery
item.description: Patreon is overhauling how creators get discovered, adding short-form Clips, topic-based communities, and a revamped recommendation system designed to give smaller creators more visibility.

item.title: Inertia Enterprises finds a way to make its fusion fuel fast
item.description: Fusion power startup Inertia Enterprises reduced the fuel filling process from a week to just a few hours. It's one of 10 hurdles the company must overcome to make a profitable power plant.

item.title: US Army is phasing out its futuristic drone and robot assault battalion, as part of a 'back-to-basics' approach
item.description: Gen. Christopher LaNeve wants the US Army to go "back-to-basics", and that means the drone battalion will be phased out.

item.title: Google now allows you to add your favorite new sources to Search
item.description: Google is adding more options to customize your search and Discover experiences.

item.title: What to make of OpenAI’s pause on its march toward superintelligence
item.description: A new model called Astra may have crossed a dangerous cybersecurity line, so OpenAI hit the brakes on training runs. Welcome to AI Decoded, Fast Company‘s weekly newsletter that breaks down the most important news in the world of AI. I’m Mark Sullivan, a senior writer at Fast Company, covering emerging tech, AI, and tech policy.

item.title: There are less than 48 hours to save up to $300 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
item.description: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

item.title: Tesla's Robotaxi fleet might finally be driving around Austin unsupervised
item.description: It's been slow going, but it looks like Tesla's Robotaxi fleet in Austin is operating fully autonomously.

item.title: The Geekom A5 delivers a 'thoughtful design' that handles office work better than most budget mini PCs we've tested — and it's now $449 at Amazon
item.description: Geekom's 4-star A5 mini PC is a top pick for office work and general computing, and comes with AMD Ryzen 5 7430U, upgradeable 16GB DDR4 RAM, and 1TB NVMe SSD.

item.title: On a testé la Marstek Venus-D : la batterie solaire la plus équipée du marché à ce tarif
item.description: La Marstek Venus-D empile jusqu'à 15,36 kWh de batterie, avale 4 kW de panneaux solaires et se recharge aussi bien au soleil que sur le réseau. Son matériel tient la route, son logiciel un peu moins, et c'est précisément ce qui décide à qui elle s'adresse.

item.title: It’s Greg Brockman’s OpenAI now
item.description: OpenAI has had a hell of a year. The company spent months battling former co-founder Elon Musk in a sensational jury trial, was hit with a high-profile trade secrets lawsuit from Apple, and faced widespread scrutiny after an unreleased model hacked another AI company. As it prepares for an IPO, a steady string of executives […]

item.title: Can AI solve the energy problem it created?
item.description: We have all the electricity we need to power AI’s data center demand—and AI can unlock it for next to nothing. It costs about $5 and takes roughly 15 minutes to train an AI model that can help determine where America’s next data centers should be built.

item.title: 40 000 km d’affilée sans toucher le volant : Tesla pousse-t-il ses conducteurs à l’irresponsabilité totale ?
item.description: Un homme a parcouru près de 40 000 km d’une seule traite avec le FSD Tesla. Il s’est vu récompensé par le système, qui encourage vivement un usage intensif de la conduite autonome, quels que soient les risques.

item.title: Dyson's popular bladeless tower fan delivers cool, clean air — and it just dropped to its lowest price yet at Amazon
item.description: Dyson's premium tower fan, which cools and cleans the air, just got a rare discount on Amazon and is on sale at its lowest price yet.

item.title: Garmin Fenix 8 Solar : la meilleure montre GPS des sportifs devient enfin recommandable avec 250 € de remise
item.description: Excellente sur le papier, la Garmin Fenix 8 Solar traînait jusqu'ici un gros point noir : un tarif de lancement au-delà des 1 000 euros qui la rendait bien difficile à recommander. Heureusement, sa facture s'allège enfin chez I-Run où elle passe à 849 euros.

item.title: This app makes the Pixel 11’s HiLight feature actually useful
item.description: Google's new HiLight notification LED on the Pixel 11 Pro is nearly useless. Out of the box, the only two things it can glow for are when the phone is face down and you're interacting with Gemini, or when you get a call from a favorite contact. And even then, it can only glow one […]

item.title: Scammers pose as ransomware recovery agents, but just go on to steal more from victims
item.description: Ransom Busters are not an actual ransomware recovery firm - they're ransomware affiliates looking to steal your money, too.

item.title: You can soon stream Crunchyroll on your car's infotainment system
item.description: The Crunchyroll anime streaming service has started appearing on the Appning app store.

item.title: Rendre sa Livebox coûte plus cher, encore : Orange et Sosh augmentent leurs frais de résiliation
item.description: Orange et Sosh viennent de revoir leur grille tarifaire et suivent une tendance déjà observée plusieurs fois ces derniers mois, celle de l'augmentation des frais de résiliation. Celle-ci ne concerne que les forfaits internet et passe de 60 à 69 euros, soit neuf euros de plus.

item.title: The live-service elements of Horizon Hunters Gathering are reportedly being stripped out following 'poor feedback' as new details emerge about several canceled PlayStation titles
item.description: Guerilla Games is reportedly overhauling Horizon Hunters Gathering and stripping out the game's live-service elements following negative feedback.

item.title: 10/10 en laboratoire : Decathlon dévoile l’antivol vélo le plus résistant de toute son histoire
item.description: Loin de se contenter de proposer des antivols vélo abordables pour un usage quotidien, Decathlon lance un produit haut de gamme très résistant face aux meuleuses.

item.title: Windows 11 : cette nouvelle fonction est si pratique qu’on se demande pourquoi elle n’existait pas avant
item.description: Dans le dernier build expérimental de Windows 11, un internaute a découvert que Microsoft teste un changement dans la gestion de l'accès au micro et à la caméra par les applications installées sur le PC.

item.title: IPVanish wants your help testing its next big features, and joining takes seconds
item.description: IPVanish has opened up beta testing so users can try new VPN features early in exchange for feedback. Here's what's on offer and how to opt in.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks and NTT DATA team up on a $1 billion AI security push
item.description: The companies are expanding their partnership to automate security operations and bring Palo Alto’s identity tools deeper into large enterprises. An AI agent deployed inside a bank or hospital system does not sit still. It queries databases, moves files, and calls other software on its own schedule. To do any of that, it needs credentials, just like an employee does. In February, Palo Alto Networks put the ratio at more than 80 machine accounts for every human one inside a typical enterprise. Most security teams cannot produce a full list of them, so they cannot say who or what has access to t...

item.title: The latest GTA 6 leak shows Vice City from above — and the level of detail is simply staggering
item.description: New GTA 6 leak shows an urban scale that I didn't even think was possible in games.

item.title: 'The best wireless mouse for enhancing workplace productivity': Logitech's MX Master 3S offers quiet clicks, MagSpeed scrolling and extensive customization, and it's on sale at Amazon
item.description: Logitech MX Master 3S is our favorite wireless mouse for work, packing quiet clicks, MagSpeed scrolling and extensive customization.

item.title: La France est-elle devenue une « passoire » ? Le manque de spécialistes en cybersécurité inquiète
item.description: Le nombre de cyberattaques s’est multiplié ces derniers mois en France. Le marché de la cybersécurité est sous tension et la demande de nouvelles recrues n’a jamais été aussi forte. Le problème : les candidats qualifiés manquent sur le marché.

item.title: Australia passes law to charge tech companies levies unless they reach deals with news publishers
item.description: Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn will have to pay millions to support local news outlets under Australia's new rules.

item.title: 'A thoughtfully engineered slice of modern computing': GMKtec K13 AI mini PC packs Core Ultra 7 power for video editing and it's $310 off right now
item.description: The GMKtec K13 is a 'thoughtfully engineered' AI mini PC that impressed us during testing, packing Core Ultra 7 power, Arc graphics and 1TB storage.

item.title: Coup de théâtre chez Porsche : la voiture électrique iconique de la marque bientôt menacée ?
item.description: Contrairement à ce qui avait été précédemment annoncé, Porsche compte bien mettre un terme à la production de la Taycan selon un nouveau rapport. On ignore cependant si l’auto sera indirectement remplacée ou disparaîtra sans aucune descendance.
